summary: On December 31, 2025, at 5:55 am, Alaska State Troopers received a report of a man who had been shot on Winch Road in Fairbanks. While on scene, troopers heard gunshots coming from the incident location. Samsa barricaded himself in the residence and refused commands to surrender. title: AST SWAT Response: Willow [AK25116299]
summary: On Nov. 19, 2025, the Alaska Bureau of Investigation’s Child Abuse Investigation Unit responded to a report of a malnourished infant. Investigators obtained a search warrant and probable cause to arrest Joseph Jones on a charge of endangering the welfare of a child. The SWAT team was activated because of concerns for the child’s safety and prior contacts with Jones. title: AST Failure To Salvage Moose: Farewell GMU 19C [AK25091599]
summary: On 09/08/2025, McGrath AWT contacted two hunters with a dead 52" bull moose at the Farewell Strip. Investigation determined Jeffery Harris, age 42 of Anchorage, took the moose on the evening of September 5th. The moose was left in the field for approximately 14 hours before being field dressed. Temperatures throughout the region were warm and wet. The meat of the moose spoiled due to not being properly cared for in a timely manner. Investigation also determined Harris took the two front shoulders, and other chunks of meat, and discarded them in the brush due to their putrid smell and colors. Harris was issued a citation for failing to salvage all edible meat. The moose rack and rotten meat were seized as evidence. Arraignment was set for October 9, 2025, in the Aniak Court.

Despite these efforts, Foreman was declared deceased at the facility. His next of kin have been notified, and his body has been sent to the State Medical Examiner’s Office for autopsy.

title: AST Search and Rescue: Indian Valley Trail [AK25037053]
summary: Alaska State Troopers, in coordination with the Alaska Mountain Rescue Group (AMRG), successfully rescued a hiker in distress near the Indian Creek Trailhead late Saturday night. At approximately 11:22 PM on April 19, authorities received an SOS activation from a Garmin device belonging to a 52-year-old male hiking alone in the Indian Creek area. The hiker, who had undergone knee replacement surgery last October, was reported overdue by a companion waiting at the trailhead. The rescue operation proceeded despite a brief cancellation of the SOS call, as the hiker later reported he couldn't feel his feet. After midnight, the Alaska Mountain Rescue Group was deployed to the last known coordinates. At approximately 2:55 AM, rescuers made contact with the hiker about a mile from the parking lot

summary: On 4/27/20, Alaska Wildlife Troopers on Prince of Wales Island were notified of several deer that had been taken illegally during the closed season. AWT responded to the area and located four gut-piles, each with an unborn fawn, as well as, the heads and lower legs of four adult female deer. The deer appeared to have been recently killed (within the past 12 hours). The deer had likely been shot elsewhere and then transported to the remote log landing on Saltery Point near Hydaburg, where they were gutted and processed. Several items of evidence were located at the scene, and the investigation is ongoing. Investigation resulted in Chuck Trefon, age 57 of Nondalton being indicted for Sexual Abuse of a Minor in the First Degree on February 12, 2020. A Felony, no bail arrest warrant was issued for Trefon. On March 3, 2020 AST responded to a residence in Anchorage and took Trefon into custody without incident. In addition to the SAM I warrant, Trefon was also remanded on a Misdemeanor arrest warrant, $150 Assault in the Fourth Degree.
